Frequently Asked Questions

Which is better: BYD Dolphin or MG MG4 EV? ▼
Both are excellent vehicles for export. The BYD Dolphin (Electric — 94 hp) excels with Blade Battery, while the MG MG4 EV (Electric — 201 hp) stands out with RWD. Your best choice depends on budget, range requirements, and target market preferences. Contact us for a detailed comparison.
Which is cheaper to import? ▼
The BYD Dolphin has a lower FOB price at $18,999 – $22,999, compared to the MG MG4 EV at $24,999 – $29,999. However, total import cost also depends on shipping method, destination port, and local import duties.
Can I import both BYD and MG cars from China? ▼
Absolutely. We source from all major Chinese manufacturers including BYD and MG. Mixed-brand orders are welcome.
Which Chinese car brand is more popular in Georgia? ▼
Both BYD and MG are gaining popularity in Georgia. BYD currently leads in the EV segment. Contact us for the latest sales data.
